newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Shell, Occidental Philippine units seek gas deal.
newsitem.headline: Shell, Occidental Philippine units seek gas deal.

text.p: Shell Philippines Exploration B.V. and Occidental Philippines have resumed negotiations with the National Power Corp (Napocor) for a gas supply and purchase agreement, the Department of Energy said on Thursday.
Energy Minister Francisco Viray told reporters Shell Philippines and Occidental were given up to the first quarter of 1997 to finalize the gas supply agreement with Napocor.
Shell Philippines is a unit of the Royal Dutch Shell group. Occidental Philippines is a unit of Occidental Petroleum Corp.
Napocor is planning to use the gas to fuel its 1,200-megawatt power plant in Ilijan, Batangas.
Negotiations between the two firms and the government over the gas supply agreement were halted last year because of delays in the start of construction of the Ilijan power plant.
